# BACTERIAL MENINGITIS (WITHOUT GRAM STAIN RESULTS)

Once a diagnosis of acute bacterial meningitis is considered likely,

antimicrobials should be initiated as soon as possible. Two blood cultures

should be drawn. Lumbar puncture (LP) should be performed in nearly all patients

to obtain cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) for establishing diagnosis and determining

infectious organism/susceptibility. Adjust antimicrobial regimen to optimize

therapy and treatment duration based on pathogen once isolated.

Intravenous dexamethasone therapy improves outcomes for meningitis with

Streptococcus pneumoniae and is recommended for empirical treatment of all

community acquired cases that might be associated with S. pneumoniae.

Dexamethasone must be given before (1 to 20 minutes) with antimicrobials.

If meningococcal meningitis is identified, antimicrobial prophylaxis should be

considered for close contacts. Contact Infectious Diseases/Epidemiology for

advice and assistance.

# Consult Infectious Diseases

# Step 1 of Treatment

[Dexamethasone 10 mg IV q6h \($\) for 4 days](psjzid-dexamethasone-10mg-iv-q6h-4d)

(Discontinue if isolated pathogen is not S. pneumoniae)

# _______________________________________________________________________________

# Step 2 of Treatment, Select One of the Following:

# Treatment for Adults < 50 Years Without Alcoholism, Debilitating Disease, or

# Any Other Condition Associated with Impaired Cellular Immunity.

Preferred:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-ceftriax-2gm-q12h-and-vanco-15mg-kg-q12h)

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

# Treatment for Adults >= 50 Years or With Alcoholism, Debilitating Disease, or

# Impaired Cellular Immunity. Listeria Monocytogenes is One Important Pathogen.

Preferred:

[Ampicillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R <AND> ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M <AND>](orz-set-abx-ampicillin-ceftriax-vancomycin)

vancomycin 15mg/kg q12h ($) [R]

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Moxifloxacin 400mg IV q24h \($$\) R,DI <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-moxiflox-iv-q24h-vanco-iv-q12h-tmp-sulfa-iv-q6h)

<AND> trimethoprim 5 mg/kg - sulfamethoxazole 25 mg/kg IV q6h ($$$) [R,DI]
